description: Design system CSS rewrite and App cleanup. Fully rewrite src/index.css with the single canonical :root token block, all pc-* class definitions (written from scratch — they currently don't exist), all legacy alias classes (.btn, .card, .inp, .badge, .drt-table, .alert, etc.) rewritten to use canonical tokens with geometry rules (border-radius: 0 block, 2px inline), nav classes with mobile hamburger, print media query, and all utility classes. Clear App.css to a comment. Confirm App.tsx has no App.css import (it does not — confirmed by reading the file).
